title: writing-transformer-contract
description: The contract every writing-<noun> skill inherits: its run function's args shape (the write-spec, per code/transformers/writing.md's stated domain) and its return shape (the witness, per the stated codomain). The `input` and `output` sub-schemas are the per-skill contract the MCP harness compiles and enforces at invocation time.

path.description: The address being written to: absolute, or relative to repo_root.

content.description: The bytes to write. Validity of the bytes as a typed instance of the named noun (e.g. a resource-file) is a post-write lint concern, not an input-gate concern.

if_exists.description: Disposition when the target file already exists.

repo_root.description: Repository root used to resolve relative paths. Defaults to CWD.

path.description: Absolute path of the written file.

created.description: True iff the file did not exist before this call.

skipped.description: True iff if_exists=skip and the file pre-existed; in that case bytes_written is zero.

bytes_written.description: Byte count written. Zero on skip.
